# g3p - Lean Asset Management Consulting

> > g3p delivers Lean Asset Management consulting, ISO 55000 implementation, and digital transformation services to drive operational excellence and productivity across global industries.

g3p is a specialized consulting firm focused on Lean Asset Management, ISO 55000-55002 standards implementation, and organizational transformation using PDCA methodology. The firm serves clients across pharmaceutical, airport, automotive, and food & beverage sectors, with expertise in asset lifecycle management, risk management, and enterprise digitalization.

## Key Topics

- Lean Asset Management
- ISO 55000/55001/55002
- Asset Lifecycle Management
- Digital Transformation
- Operational Excellence
- ISO 9001 Quality Management
- Risk Management (ISO 31000)
- Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)
- PDCA Methodology
- Process Optimization
- Preventive Maintenance
- Strategic Asset Management Plan
- Integrated Management Systems
- Change Management
- OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
